_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Source/Vendor List/Foreign List
summary: The Source/Vendor List/Foreign List identifies all sources used by the prime contractor to procure subcontracted items, enabling the government to track parts selection, qualification, and identification.
description_purpose: The Source/Vendor List/Foreign List identifies a complete listing of all sources used by the prime contractor in procuring any subcontracted item. It is a means for the government to track parts selection, qualification, and identification of parts.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-80894.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: General.
preparation_instructions.content: The listing is to be compiled from contractor invoices, purchase orders, etc., and not from existing Government furnished documentation and shall include only contractor, subcontractor, and vendor items. The contractor shall revise this listing throughout the contract to reflect all subsequent changes. Negative responses are required.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The listing may be in the contractor's format and shall be listed in alphanumerical order by part number.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The list shall include the following:

children.title: Part number.
children.content: The original manufacturer's part number shall be supplied by the subcontractor and vendors.

children.title: Name and address of the original manufacturer.
Specification controlled item (if applicable).
children.content: The specification control number and the CAGE code shall be included.

children.title: Source controlled item (if applicable).
children.content: The approved vendors part number and CAGE code shall be included.

preparation_instructions.title: Foreign sources.
preparation_instructions.content: Foreign sources shall include 10.3 and the following:

children.title: Description of the part to include the level of dependency, and the first and second level vendor name.
Reason for utilizing each foreign source (i.e., cost, schedule, quality, sole source, etc.)
Items which are co-produced by the National Alliance Treaty Organization (NATO) partners.
